## Summary

Describe the user-visible problem and the scoped change.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant user flow tested against a compatible backend

## Compatibility

- [ ] API paths, methods, query parameters, and request bodies are unchanged or documented
- [ ] Authentication and authorization behavior is unchanged or documented
- [ ] English and Chinese UI states were checked when affected
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, personal data, or private infrastructure details are included
